description: This file defines the 'OAuthAuthorizationCode' entity class for use with Doctrine ORM in a PHP project. It models OAuth2 authorization code data, including code, client ID, user ID, redirect URI, expiry, and revocation status, along with getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OAuthAuthorizationCode
classes.description: An entity class representing OAuth2 authorization codes in the database.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the authorization code record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier of the authorization code record.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with the authorization code.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID who requested the authorization code.

methods.name: getRedirectUri
methods.description: Returns the redirect URI associated with the authorization code.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the expiry DateTimeImmutable of the authorization code, set to UTC timezone.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry DateTimeImmutable of the authorization code.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Returns whether the authorization code has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the authorization code.
